svg.title: European Tech Opportunities 2027 — repository overview
svg.desc: Configuration and the CLI drive permission-gated collection with persistent oldest-completed search rotation and a separate bounded availability audit. Repository is the only application writer to canonical SQLite. HTTP 429 stops source requests; completed searches can publish only after quality and integrity gates and manual review. Other source denials and all audit denials block publication. The website, API, exports, and README are read-only projections.
